pr_title: Fix timeline thumbnail zoom can't scale beyond 1:1 pixels (fix #4974)

issue_context.title: Timeline thumbnail zoom can't scale beyond 1:1 pixels, even for very small images, making them hard to see on 4k monitors.
issue_context.body: When using large thumbnail sizes on the timeline with smaller sprites, instead of enlarging the thumbnail image to fit the full area available, aseprite just adds transparent whitespace around the thumbnail image. It would be great if there was an option to have it match the thumbnail size and zoom the the image to fill that space, especially on high dpi/4k monitors. As you can see from the example image, right now the thumbnails aren't making good use of the space and are very hard to see.
